title: Stalk of a scheme at a point of an affine open: the canonical open immersion and the localization
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq X$ an affine open, $R=\mathcal O_X(U)$, and $\iota_U:\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$ the canonical open immersion with image $U$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-spec-points], [def-weil-open-immersion]; for $x\in U$ let $\mathfrak p_x\subset R$ be the prime with $\iota_U(\mathfrak p_x)=x$ (unique, $\iota_U$ being injective). Identify $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R})$ with $R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then: (a) the ring map $\iota_U^\sharp:\mathcal O_X(U)\to\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R}(\iota_U^{-1}(U))=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R})=R$ is the identity of $R$; (b) for every $x\in U$ the stalk map $\iota^\sharp_{U,\mathfrak p_x}:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}R,\mathfrak p_x}$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] is an isomorphism of rings, and it sends the germ $r_x$ of $r\in R=\mathcal O_X(U)$ to the germ at $\mathfrak p_x$ of the global section $r$ of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ (germs as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]); (c) for every $x\in U$ the germ map $R\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $r\mapsto r_x$, is a localization of $R$ at $R\setminus\mathfrak p_x$: $s_x$ is a unit for every $s\in R\setminus\mathfrak p_x$, every element of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is $r_xs_x^{-1}$ with $r\in R$, $s\in R\setminus\mathfrak p_x$, and $r_x=0$ implies $tr=0$ for some $t\in R\setminus\mathfrak p_x$; hence $R_{\mathfrak p_x}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $r/s\mapsto r_xs_x^{-1}$, is an isomorphism of rings [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].
